expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no button'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return { filterTabs: ['All','Queued','Running','Completed','Failed','Cancelled'].filter(x => t.includes(x)), modelDatalist: !!document.getElementById('engine-models') }; })()

(() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')); const target = rows.find(r => r.innerText.includes('Engine P3 live proof')); if (!target) return 'row not found: ' + rows.length; const b = target.querySelector('button'); b.click(); return 'clicked P3 row'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const dlg = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); return { dlgOpen: !!dlg, liveBadge: t.includes('live'), stepRows: dlg ? dlg.querySelectorAll('ol li').length : -1 }; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return { resultAndCopy: t.includes('Result') && t.includes('Copy'), reRunButton: t.includes('Re-run'), liveGone: !t.includes('live') }; })()
